Module 2 (continued)

The data available, with Microsoft (3/3)

2.11 ESG

Overviews › ESG

What our access shows for Microsoft:

  • ESG Scores & Ratings: ISS corporate rating (B-, "Good"); RepRisk rating (N/A for Microsoft); internal score (none published). Sustainalytics is not included.
  • FactSet ESG Thematic Involvement: revenue exposure to ESG themes (here Artificial Intelligence, 4 products).
  • Key Items: emissions (Scope 1, 2, 3, totals) and intensity per million USD of revenue or enterprise value. For Microsoft FY26 these cells are empty (-) in our access.
  • ESG Notifications: ESG news and StreetAccount items about the company. The tab Peers & Suppliers compares with peers. Links at the top give the latest CSR/ESG document.

2.12 Options

My Apps › Markets & Industry › Options

  • Options Montage: the option chain by expiry (Nov '26, Dec '26, Jan '27…). For each strike: last price, change, bid, ask, volume and open interest for calls and puts; at the top the underlying price and total option volume.
  • Options Calculator: theoretical value and Greeks of an option. Options Strategy: payoff of combinations.

2.13 Funds and ETFs

Search the fund (e.g. IVV) › Overviews › Fund Overview — Holdings › Holder Summary · Holdings Activity

  • Fund Overview: classification (asset class, region, size), description, NAV and price, returns over 1M to 10Y vs benchmark, return ranking among peers.
  • Holder Summary (the fund as an investor): assets ($882,461 million), style, top 10 weight (37.56%), top buys and sells, top 10 sectors, and Top 20 Holdings by Market Value with weight, change, value, report date (10/30/2026) and ticker. Holdings Activity: changes by sector, country and size.

2.14 Markets, economics, FX, rates and commodities

Top bar › Markets — My Apps › Economics · Calendar · Time & Sales

  • Markets: world indices, commodities, fixed income (interbank rates), the Fed policy-rate tracker, yield curves and a currency matrix. The left menu has Equities, Fixed Income, Commodities, ETFs and FX folders.
  • Economics: calendar of releases (country, indicator, actual, consensus, surprise, prior) plus tabs Country/Region, Comparison, Estimates, Policy Rates.
  • Time & Sales: every trade of the day (time, price, volume, exchange, bid/ask).

Official documentation: Economics tab tipsheet (PDF) · Markets tab tipsheet (PDF)

2.15 Screening: building lists

My Apps › Research › Screening — tabs Universal Screening and Screen On

A screen answers "which securities or deals meet my criteria?". You add criteria, FactSet returns the list, you choose the columns and download it.

  • Universal Screening: universes Equity, ETF, Debt (bonds), Activism/Governance, Holders. The Fund and Account universes are greyed out: not in our access. Suggested screens (CEO changes, share repurchases, revenue by region…) are ready-made examples.
  • Screen On: screening of transactions (256,060 in the screenshot): criteria Key Criteria, Company Details, M&A, PE/VC, PIPE, Industry, Advisors & Fees; result tabs Transactions, Targets/Issuers, Buyers/Investors, Financial and Legal Advisors, Bookrunners. Results are limited to the top 204,701 rows for performance.

Official documentation: Equity Screening tipsheet (PDF) · Screen On tipsheet (PDF)

ESGOverviews › ESGFormula (codes from Insert Formula) or download
